dedupe_keys.name: amr automotive lithium ion battery recycling matlab model

description: The AMR research team publishes a MATLAB module for estimating retired automotive lithium-ion battery recycling costs and greenhouse gas emissions in China. Its GitHub README specifies 337 prefecture-level cities, six cathode chemistries and annual model years from 2020 to 2060. The public tree includes main.m, amr.m and a Parameters directory. Code is free to access under Apache 2.0. It can generate location- and chemistry-specific assumptions for waste-service and transport-electrification simulations. A caveat is that the README describes only this AMR module, not a complete network optimization workflow. Input prices, processes, emission factors and battery-retirement estimates must be checked before transferring results. The own metadata, README and tree were inspected without executing MATLAB or comparing generated numbers with the separate Figshare workbook. The model has not been verified against operating recycling plants; no exact related catalogue model was identified.
